feature_contract.goal: Remove redundant eager full-buffer zero initialization during R26+HUD VB/IB CPU shadow's first small Lock/Unlock write while preserving all valid-byte and stereo fallback correctness.
feature_contract.scope_boundary: Shipped R26+HUD dynamic VB/IB CPU shadow backing storage and its portable regression smoke; no producer/sprite/GOAL/lens/FFB/graphics effects, shader, DX11 or DXVK mutation.
feature_contract.special_work_evidence: Original R26+HUD source used std::vector<uint8_t>::resize(desc.Size) before memcpy of a much smaller observed write; this value-initializes up to 16 MiB even though per-byte valid interval checks disallow the untouched memory. Source-confirmed elimination of full-size first-write zeroing, without claiming measured hardware FPS.
trace_stages: Original D3D9 game dynamic vertex/index buffer Lock and Unlock provide only an observed write offset and byte span to the R26+HUD CPU shadow.
Game capture allocates backing byte storage and copies observed Lock/Unlock bytes, independently registering only those valid intervals and clearing them on DISCARD.
R26+HUD stereo draw-time readback checks the interval coverage before reading shadow bytes; absent or invalid bytes force unchanged game rendering fallback.
Active package compiles stereo_renderer_r30_r26_safe.cpp, and Windows host smoke covers allocation, partial copy, DISCARD and restoration without using HMD as compile proof.
subcomponents: Replace first-write vector zero-fill for both shipped VB and IB CPU shadow with a lazy uninitialized buffer, preserving size/data/clear/resize interfaces and fallible allocation behavior.
Keep exact valid byte range gating on both vertex and index reads, non-overlapping copy boundaries, DISCARD invalidation and device lifecycle release unaffected.
Run portable Windows host executable with captured partial-byte payload, gap negatives, allocation reuse and clear/discard recovery plus existing 16k-range differential regression.

acceptance_items.behavior_area: Shipped R26+HUD vertex and index shadow initial capture
acceptance_items.expected_behavior: A partial Lock/Unlock copies only observed bytes into an allocated backing buffer without eager full-size zero initialization, while later same-size writes reuse storage.

acceptance_items.behavior_area: Shadow validity, DISCARD and device-lifetime recovery
acceptance_items.expected_behavior: Allocation does not imply readable bytes: non-covered gaps always reject, discarded ranges are invalidated, and cleared backing memory cannot inherit prior coverage.

acceptance_items.behavior_area: Packaged Windows game and x64 host integration
acceptance_items.expected_behavior: The exact validation-bearing SHA passes DX9Ex Active host/game/package, Domain Isolation, Full Source Impact and HUD Inspector where applicable with portable regression target.

diagnosis.original_evidence: In selected packaged R26+HUD owner, R30FinishObservedLock resizes vector<uint8_t> to full D3D9 buffer size on first observed lock and immediately overwrites only [lockOffset, lockOffset+lockSize).
diagnosis.root_cause: std::vector<uint8_t>::resize value-initializes all unobserved elements on first capture (up to 16 MiB), producing unnecessary CPU bandwidth/memory cache work unrelated to stereo validity.
source_trace: Vertex/index Lock hooks capture observed pointer, source offset and effective size for game-owned write before Unlock.
R30FinishObservedLock allocates backing bytes and memcpy writes partial buffer, then merges valid interval coverage independently from backing byte allocation.
R30CopyVertexShadow/R30CopyIndexShadow reject any read not covered by valid intervals; R30 stereo eye replay falls back on rejected reads.
alternatives_rejected: Do not assume unobserved bytes can be read or remove coverage checks; do not resize the shadow to only the last observed region because later offset-based copies need full-address backing; do not change GPU draw admission or shaders.
diagnosis.fix_evidence: The packaged R26+HUD R30BufferShadow bytes now use LazyUninitializedBuffer::resize(new uint8_t[size]) and preserve data, size, reuse and clear, while existing Merge/Contains validity and draw fallback remain untouched.
diagnosis.negative_test_evidence: New host smoke asserts untouched interval gaps rejected, DISCARD removes coverage, same-capacity reuse preserves observed payload, clear drops pointer and size and fresh allocation starts invalid; original random differential intervals remain.

runtime_evidence: No Quest3/VDXR or same-scene hardware FPS measurement. Automated smoke and Windows compile are not VR acceptance.
